paper.title_en: Every 3D Conformal Field Theory Has an <math display="inline"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi mathvariant="script">L</mi></mrow><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">Λ</mi></mrow></msub><msub><mrow><mi>w</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>∞</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></math> Symmetry
paper.abstract_en: A one-parameter family of deformed <math display="inline"><mrow><mi mathvariant="script">L</mi><msub><mrow><mi>w</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>∞</mi></mrow></msub></mrow></math> soft symmetry algebras acting on tree-level gravitational theories in <math display="inline"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>AdS</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></math> has recently been discovered; it is denoted <math display="inline"><msub><mi mathvariant="script">L</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Λ</mi></msub><msub><mi>w</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>∞</mi></mrow></msub></math>. Here, we show that all <math display="inline"><mrow><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>CFT</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>3</mn></mrow></msub><mtext> </mtext></mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">s</mi></mrow></math>, including those dual to quantum gravity on <math display="inline"><mrow><msub><mrow><mi>AdS</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>4</mn></mrow></msub></mrow></math>, admit an <math display="inline"><msub><mi mathvariant="script">L</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">Λ</mi></msub><msub><mi>w</mi><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><mi>∞</mi></mrow></msub></math> action generated by the ANEC operator, its conformal descendants, and their commutators. This extends previous tree-level results on these soft symmetries to the strongly coupled quantum regime.
